title: Portable archive contract
summary: Portable archives carry manifest-bound QA and shared-file bytes across local, self-host and hosted moves. Validation checks digests, import uses destination storage, and missing files are reported. Two-member backup archives remain valid. Hosted Download checks size before pausing, caps archives at 10 GiB, and issues a signed link valid for one hour; Import fetches from configured buckets and restores artifacts before serving. Every mode exports only public database objects, excluding capability-secret data, environment instrumentation, extensions and source-authority fence state; import rejects nonportable catalog entries.
